# VoltaMission

> Technical sourcing and qualification for hard-to-find battery cells, fuel-cell
> components, and manufacturing equipment. VoltaMission helps North American hardware
> teams and research groups find and technically vet specialized components that
> distributors and marketplaces cannot supply.

VoltaMission is a technical sourcing and qualification advisory founded by engineers with
deep, hands-on expertise in battery cell manufacturing, laser process engineering, cell
materials, and laser applications (team pedigree includes Tesla, Canoo, A123 Systems, and
leading laser companies). The product is engineering judgment: identifying the right
component or piece of equipment
for an application and qualifying the vendor on technical merit. This is not commodity
reselling — buyers pay to be de-risked.

## What VoltaMission does
- Technical sourcing of hard-to-find battery cells, fuel-cell components, and equipment,
  especially small-volume and R&D quantities that volume-focused distributors ignore.
- Vendor qualification on technical merit: specifications, manufacturing capability, and
  legitimacy.
- Cross-border equipment and process sourcing between Asia and North America.

## Who it serves
- North American hardware manufacturers and startups with hard-to-source component needs.
- University research centers and research groups needing specialized cells or fuel-cell
  components in R&D quantities.
